analysis: Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) is the hormone secreted by the placenta shortly after fertilization. It is detected in pregnancy tests as it is present in the blood and urine of pregnant women very early in pregnancy, making it a reliable marker for early pregnancy detection.
